description: Inputs of the report figures, extracted from runs/pbt manifests and runs/eval pair analyses by scripts/reports/publication_figures.py --refresh. Trajectories: (training epoch, lowest LR, highest LR, best Validation (1M) mistag so far in %). Pairs: disagreement on Validation (1M) in % and ensemble improvement in % (mistag reduction against the better model of the pair).

overview.sources: runs/eval/<campaign>/analysis.json (Test (2.8M)); published/results/large_dataset/sealed_test_checkpoints.csv (Test (9.0M)); runs/eval/holdout_block_bootstrap_v1 (intervals); runs/eval/holdout_ensemble_8m_dev_v1, ensemble_seed22345_v1, ensemble_seed32345_v1 (ensembles); runs/pbt/<run>/manifest.json (Validation (150k) per constant-LR model and selected LRs). Epochs of ensemble models are Weaver epochs (training epoch + 17).
